Method of Attack: Information-stealing Trojan disguised as a PDF reader
Steals Facebook and Amazon session cookies
Extracts sensitive data from Facebook Ads Manager using stolen session cookies and access tokens
Uses Facebook Graph API calls to steal Ads Manager data including payment methods, credit card info, PayPal email, ad balances, spending limits
Sends stolen data to attacker Command & Control server
Impacted Systems: Facebook sessions in Chrome and Firefox
Attack Vector: Distributed via adware bundles installing unwanted programs such as YeaDesktop or pretending to be copyrighted software
Silently executed Trojan running in background without user awareness
Indicators of Compromise: Executables signed by Sectigo to 'Rakete Content Gmbh'

URLs accessed for Facebook data extraction: https://www.facebook.com/bookmarks/pages?ref_type=logout_gear, https://secure.facebook.com/settings, https://secure.facebook.com/ads/manager/account_settings/account_billing/
